## Core Services

### 1. Custom Web Applications
- Production-grade, high-performance web applications engineered for scalability and security.
- Admin dashboards, management software, enterprise portals, and role-based access control.
- Technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS.

### 2. SaaS Development & MVP Launch
- End-to-end SaaS engineering from initial prototype to production scale.
- Multi-tenant architectures, subscription billing (Stripe/PayPal/Razorpay), user authentication, usage metrics, and analytics dashboards.

### 3. AI Automation & Intelligent Agents
- Custom AI-driven business workflows, chatbots, customer service automation, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.
- Automated pipeline orchestration using Python, LangChain, OpenAI APIs, and n8n.

### 4. API Development & Third-Party Integration
- Scalable REST and GraphQL API development, webhook systems, and secure third-party service connections (payment gateways, CRMs, ERPs).

### 5. Cloud Deployment & DevOps
- Automated CI/CD pipelines, Docker containerization, VPS & cloud setups (AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean, Vercel), SSL, caching, and performance monitoring.

### 6. Maintenance & Support
- Security updates, bug fixes, database optimizations, and complimentary 30 days of post-launch warranty support on every delivered project.

## Key Case Studies & Portfolio

1. **Laundry Express (On-Demand Booking & Payment Platform)**
   - Modern service booking platform with integrated Stripe payment processing and customer booking management.
   - Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, Stripe.
   - Live: https://www.laundryexpressservices.com/

2. **CallBell (SaaS Platform)**
   - QR-based real-time voice and video communication platform with enterprise encryption and usage-based billing.
   - Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.io, LiveKit.
   - Live: https://callbell.in/

3. **Sewamahe (Expert Consultation Platform)**
   - Real-time video consultation platform connecting users with verified professionals, instant matching, and automated scheduling.
   - Stack: React, TypeScript, Redux, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.io, LiveKit.
   - Live: https://sewamahe.in/

4. **Pulse Pixel (Digital Subscription Platform)**
   - Platform providing subscription management for premium learning and developer tools.
   - Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.io.
   - Live: https://thepulsepixel.com/

5. **Empori Anxo Medicare (EAML)**
   - Corporate medical equipment catalogue and distribution platform with dynamic inventory filtering and Filament admin.
   - Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Laravel, MySQL.
   - Live: https://emporianxomedicare.com/

6. **Akatsuki (Modern E-Commerce & Media Platform)**
   - High-speed digital commerce platform featuring secure checkout, dynamic catalogs, and custom content management.
   - Live: https://akatsuki-ivory.vercel.app/

## How to Book a Free Consultation
Strix Devs offers a **100% free, no-obligation 30-minute consultation on Google Meet**:
1. Visit https://strixdevs.com/contact or click "Book Consultation" on any page.
2. Select your project topic (SaaS MVP, Custom Web App, AI Automation, Cloud/DevOps).
3. Pick an available date and convenient 30-minute time slot.
4. Receive an instant Google Meet room link, calendar invite (.ics), and confirmation email.
